scoring_justification: The checker recomputes far-field averages, wall-center values, and peak features from the agent's spatial profiles and compares them against the paper's reported bulk constants and expected shapes; no hidden test labels needed.

outputs.description: Unit-cell resolved spontaneous polarization component P3 across the 180° domain wall in tetragonal KNbO3 at 270°C for four domain wall thicknesses. The checker verifies far-field magnitude and profile shape against reference values.

Unit-cell resolved principal refractive indices n1, n2, n3 across the 180° domain wall for four domain wall thicknesses. The checker verifies far-field values and profile shape against reference values derived from the literature.

output_contract.notes: The profiles should be computed with the domain wall centered at the Nb-O2 (100) plane. The checker verifies far-field magnitude and profile shape against reference values derived from the literature.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for domain wall profiles: bulk polarization 0.34 C/m2, ordinary refractive index 2.32, extraordinary index 2.15; shape expectations (center zero polarization, peaks for n2,n3).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.1 and text for polarization; Fig.2 and text for refractive indices.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's reported bulk values and shape descriptions.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own claimed physical constants, used to verify a correct reproduction.

checks.description: Average absolute P3 in far-field (|x|>=20 Å) must equal 0.34 within ±0.05 C/m2 for each rc.
P3 at the wall center (x≈0) must be close to zero: |P3| ≤ 0.01 C/m2 for each rc.
Far-field averages of n1,n2 must be 2.32±0.05 and n3 must be 2.15±0.05 for each rc.
n2 and n3 must show a distinct peak at the wall center: center value exceeds far-field average by at least 0.01 for each rc.
